# Debian Documentation

!!! warning "Historical migration context"
    This page is kept to trace Linxira's early Debian/Ubuntu route. It does not describe the current system and is not part of the current navigation. Linxira OS is now built directly on Arch Linux; do not apply APT or Debian package-management steps to the current system.
